_comment: The words of the game's shell: the title, the main menu and its cards (new game, load game, settings), the quit
and yes/no dialogs, start-up messages, the gas station's screen (the attendant's own lines are in station.json),
the radio and the engine's state when it is started in the garage or on a lot. A label is said one way (the first
line of its pool). {name} is a value the game fills in; money writes itself, figures come already written out or are named for what they are ({tank:fuel}, see locale.json).
.one / .other: the game picks one by the count.
menu.screen.<name>: a screen's name in menu.open_failed, the screen's own name with spaces as underscores.
{error}: newgame.failed, loadgame.list_failed, loadgame.load_failed, loadgame.delete_failed, settings.save_failed, settings.reset_failed, radio.list_failed, startup.error

{count}: loadgame.played.minutes.one, loadgame.played.minutes.other, loadgame.played.hours.one, loadgame.played.hours.other, loadgame.played.days.one, loadgame.played.days.other, loadgame.played.weeks.one, loadgame.played.weeks.other, radio.all_songs, radio.found.one, radio.found.other, radio.not_playable, radio.capped, startup.mod_problems.more
{credits}: settings.credits.garage, settings.credits.station, settings.credits.street, settings.credits.streetkit, settings.credits.sound, settings.credits.parts

Placeholders: {cost} the cost so far; {count} a count; {credit} who made the radio; {error} what went wrong; {file} a file; {files} the files, a comma between; {folder} a folder; {folders} folders; {fuel} the fuel in the tank; {hours} hours; {keep} where originals are kept; {list} a list's name; {litres} litres so far; {log} the log's folder; {minutes} minutes; {missing} the runtimes message when some are missing, else nothing; {mods} the mods, one a line; {path} a folder; {player} the player's name; {problem} why it won't start; {problems} the problems, one a line; {runtimes} the runtimes to install, one a line; {save} the save's name; {screen} a screen's name; {settings} the settings file; {station} the station's name; {tank} the tank's size; {tow} the tow truck's charge.
